result.summary: 本文提出了“精度感知”的缩放定律，用于预测语言模型在低精度训练和训练后量化下的损失 [abstract]。作者将训练精度与参数量统一为“有效参数量”N_eff，并发现训练后量化的退化随数据量增加而增大，最终可能使额外预训练数据变得有害 [S1.p1][S3.SS1.p2]。对于训练，缩放定律预测在联合优化时计算最优精度约为7-8比特，且与计算预算无关；但当模型大小固定时，计算最优精度随计算量对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p1]。作者在超过465次预训练运行上拟合，并在高达1.7B参数、26B token的模型上验证了预测 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 本文要解决的核心问题是：精度、参数量和数据量之间存在怎样的权衡，以及这些权衡在预训练和推理时有何不同 [S1.p1]。研究动机在于，当前缩放定律未考虑训练和推理精度对模型质量和成本的影响，而深度学习正趋势向更低精度发展 [abstract][S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: What are the tradeoffs between precision, parameters, and data? How do they compare for pretraining and inference?
Low precision training and inference affect both the quality and cost of language models, but current scaling laws do not account for this.
Deep learning is trending towards lower precision: current frontier models like the Llama-3 series are trained in BF16, and there is widespread effort to move the pretraining paradigm to FP8.

method.text: 作者提出了“精度感知”的缩放定律，核心思想是将比特精度和参数量统一为“有效参数量”N_eff，即 N_eff = N(1-e^{-P_w/γ_w})(1-e^{-P_a/γ_a})(1-e^{-P_kv/γ_kv})，并假设权重、激活和KV缓存的量化效应独立且可乘 [S1.p2][S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。对于训练后量化，退化被建模为 δ_PTQ = C_T (D^{γ_D}/N^{γ_N}) e^{-P_post/γ_post}，并进一步修改以纳入训练精度的影响 [S3.SS1.p1][S5.p4]。最终统一缩放定律形式为 L = A N_eff^{-α} + B D^{-β} + E + δ_PTQ [S5.p8]。

evidence.quote: This functional form that posits bit precision and parameter count interchangeably contribute to a model’s “effective parameter count,” $N_{\text{eff}}$, and implementation details like which parts of a model are quantized to what precision, interact with loss scaling only through their effect on this quantity.
$N_{\text{eff}}(P)=N(1-e^{-P_{\text{w}}/\gamma_{\text{w}}})(1-e^{-P_{\text{a}}/\gamma_{\text{a}}})(1-e^{-P_{\text{kv}}/\gamma_{\text{kv}}})$
The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
$\delta_{\text{PTQ}}(N,D,P_{\text{post}})=C_{T}\left(\frac{D^{\gamma_{D}}}{N^{\gamma_{N}}}\right)e^{-P_{\text{post}}/\gamma_{\text{post}}}$

$\delta_{\text{PTQ}}(N,D,P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{post}})=C_{T}e^{-P_{\text{post}}/\gamma_{\text{post}}}\underbrace{\left(\frac{D^{\gamma_{D}}}{N_{\text{eff}}^{\gamma_{N}}}\right)}_{\text{Overtraining effect}}\underbrace{[1-e^{-C_{\text{w}}(P_{\text{w}}-P_{\text{post}})}]}_{\text{Robustification effect}}$
$L(N,D,P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}},P_{\text{post}})=AN_{\text{eff}}^{-\alpha}+BD^{-\beta}+E+\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$

experiments.text: 作者在Dolma V1.7数据集上训练和评估了一系列OLMo风格的模型，模型大小N在30M到220M参数之间，数据量D在1.5B到26B token之间，并扫描了权重、激活和KV缓存的8种精度值 [S2.SS3.p1]。总共进行了超过465次预训练运行，并在高达1.7B参数、26B token的模型上验证了预测 [abstract]。此外，还使用GPTQ、AWQ和RTN等量化方法进行了训练后量化实验 [S3.p1][A6.p1]。

evidence.quote: We train and evaluate a suite of OLMo-style models on the Dolma V1.7 dataset, using a standard Transformer++ implementation
Our experiments consist of a sweep of language model pretraining runs over $N\in[30,60,110,220]$ million parameters (non-embedding) and $D\in[1.5,3,6,13,26]$ billion tokens.
we sweep 8 values of precision for each of the (weights, activations, attention).
We fit on over 465 pretraining runs and validate our predictions on model sizes up to 1.7B parameters trained on up to 26B tokens.
we consider models trained in BF16 and use GPTQ to post-train quantize them, replicating our findings with two other methods in Appendix F.
We replicate on AWQ and round-to-nearest quantization.

findings.text: 主要发现包括：训练后量化的退化随数据量增加而增大，对于过度训练的模型，额外预训练数据可能有害 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3]。在训练中，权重、激活和KV缓存的量化效应可建模为独立且可乘，统一为有效参数量 [S4.SS2.p5]。当联合优化N、D、P时，计算最优预训练精度与计算预算无关，约为7-8比特；但当模型大小固定时，计算最优精度随计算量对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p1]。统一缩放定律在超过1000个数据点上达到R²=0.90 [S5.p6]。

evidence.quote: This finding implies that for models that will be post-train quantized, there exists an amount of pretraining data beyond which additional data is actively harmful to performance at inference-time
Overtrained language models are more sensitive to post-training quantization.
The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
which reveals that in general the optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute budget.
We find this $P^{*}$ to be around 7-8 bits when fitting our scaling law on runs with quantization done to integer type.
compute-optimal precision scales as $P^{*}(C)\propto\log C$.
We measure the fit to the data of such a functional form in Figure 7, and find a strong fit with $R^{2}=0.90$ on over 1000 data points

limitations.text: 作者明确承认的局限包括：使用固定架构来研究精度、参数和token的影响，而低精度训练常涉及架构调整以缩小与全精度模型的差距 [S6.p2]。计算成本虽与精度线性缩放，但由于系统开销，减半精度的收益通常小于2倍 [S6.p2]。仅考虑损失缩放，未进行下游模型评估 [S6.p2]。此外，作者强调趋势是提示性的而非规定性的，希望未来工作在更大模型规模上更全面地检验这些效应 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
In contrast, low precision training often involves architectural tweaks that can close much of the gap from a vanilla full precision model.
Second, while compute costs do scale linearly with precision, the gains from halving precision are usually less than 2x due to systems overhead.
Third, we only consider loss scaling without downstream model evaluations.
We emphasize that the trends we find aim to be suggestive rather than prescriptive, and hope future work can more comprehensively examine these effects at larger model scale.
